card.name: Dose words before a numeric amount
card.fires_on: The word dose or doses, or the gap just before a number, in dosing tables and threshold statements. The next text is usually a numeric amount with mg or a unit.

modes.label: Dose noun in tables
modes.description: The word dose or doses right after a qualifier such as maximum, loading or daily, before the amount.

card.writes: It suppresses ratio and percentage words, so it steers away from ratio terms and toward a plain number or amount.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a dose amount or numeric limit, where a number is expected rather than a ratio or percentage word.
